label: Instructional Item 2
stem: Mr. Smith has a rectangular table with an area of 15 square feet and another square table with an area of 9 square feet. He plans to cover both tables with tiles, where each tile has an area of 1/3 square foot. How many tiles does he need to completely cover both tables without any gaps or overlaps?

mustNotShow: the number that is the correct answer as a label
option letters A B C D
words that name the correct choice
